scope: Eight original guided Core1A and distinct independent Core1B interactive six-stage practice journeys; no native academic admission or reprinting exam tasks

lessons.guided: 2 kg horizontal box, +30 J pull, −12 J friction, 18 J net
lessons.fresh: 3 kg motorized scooter, 2 m uphill, 0.5 m rise, four force ledger

lessons.concept: Spring contact and rough-ground phase split
lessons.guided: 1 kg smooth spring-cart release k=100 N/m x=0.20 m
lessons.fresh: 2 kg spring cart k=200 N/m x=0.10 m then 0.50 m rough strip, 1 N friction

lessons.concept: Constant mechanical power, energy versus speed and graph shapes
lessons.guided: 2 kg sled with initial 2 m/s and 12 W for 1 s and 4 s, energy table and graphs
lessons.fresh: 3 kg trolley with initial 2 m/s and 18 W for 2 s and 6 s, three graph choices and 9 W boundary

lessons.concept: Distributed chain mass and changing hanging centre of mass
lessons.guided: 4 m, 2 kg uniform chain, 2 m hanging, lifted completely onto tabletop
lessons.fresh: 8 m, 4 kg rope, hanging length changes from 4 m to 2 m, full-lift boundary

lessons.concept: Choose the correct operation for force–position, potential–position and displacement–time graphs
lessons.guided: Three simple axis-labeled graphs: F–x rectangle work, U–x negative-slope force, s–t slope velocity
lessons.fresh: R triangular F–x work, S rising U–x negative force, T piecewise s–t interval velocity, F–t impulse boundary

lessons.concept: Vertical circular motion requires both energy feasibility and nonnegative taut-string tension
lessons.guided: 0.5 kg ball on 2 m string, top speed 6 m/s, top tension +4 N, bottom speed sqrt116 m/s
lessons.fresh: 1 kg ball on 1 m string initially 7 m/s at bottom, hypothetical top v²=9, tension −1 N impossible, 8 m/s boundary yields +14 N

lessons.concept: Conveyor momentum-flow modelling and separate motor power, kinetic-energy gain and frictional heat rates
lessons.guided: 1 kg/s stationary horizontal sand arriving on 2 m/s belt gives 2 N pickup force, 4 W motor power, 2 W kinetic gain, 2 W heat
lessons.fresh: Wood chips already enter at 1 m/s and leave at 4 m/s, feed rate v/2 kg/s; force 6 N, power 24 W, kinetic gain 15 W, heat 9 W; changed 2 m/s belt boundary

lessons.concept: Elastic spring energy comparison changes when fixed extension becomes fixed final applied force
lessons.guided: Ideal spring stiffnesses 100 N/m and 200 N/m at equal 0.10 m extension versus same final 10 N force
lessons.fresh: Infer Blue and Gold stiffnesses 200/400 N/m from force at 4 cm; compare energy at 5 cm and final 12 N; double final force boundary
required_prerequisites: elastic energy as triangle under force-extension graph
final equilibrium force distinct from constant force applied throughout loading

review_notes: PR #40 source-question return route remains DRAFT and was inspected but not merged or treated as academic prerequisite authority.

Original exam stems, keys, source figures and native academic statuses were not copied or modified.
Static browser code can be inspected; a UI lock is not secure answer custody or independent evidence of a child's ability.
C03 guided and fresh problems follow existing constant-power authored pack; finite initial speed avoids the idealized zero-speed constant-power singularity and no s∝t^(3/2) derivation is required.
C04 guided and fresh problems follow existing chain pack; both hanging mass and centre height change, and a child may explain their diagram using text instead of drawing.
C01/C02 browser localStorage v1 keys retained so saved prior attempts continue after expansion to four topics.

C06 is a scaffolded advanced circular-motion practice, requiring v²/r, gravity and a string-only nonnegative tension condition before the learner can independently reconstruct it.
Existing C01–C04 browser localStorage v1 keys remain unchanged after C05/C06 addition; no reset of old learners' attempts.
Only software browser simulations, not real child observations, measure layout and state transitions in this batch.
C07 steady pickup addresses only horizontal flows and incremental motor power; electric/bearing/vertical loads excluded. A source reference EX-M16 does not establish an accepted original-source join.
C08 has an unresolved selected-pilot versus consolidated-reader classification discrepancy for EX-M101; no source or demand band change made.
Existing C01–C06 browser localStorage v1 keys, initial responses, repaired text and progress state are unchanged after the C07/C08 addition.
